evidence.location: §6 risk table, row 'Relaxing U1 lets a model with claims and no documents through'
evidence.observation: The plan states: "U1 stays whenever the root owns an object type, a fact type, a constraint, an operation or an obligation (VG4-C3, one case per boundary `(p1)`); U4, U5 and U7 already refuse a root-owned span that names no declared document".

The criterion's keep-U1 cases are: "Each of these keeps U1 `(p1)`: a root with no documents that owns an object type; one that owns only a constraint attached to an included fact type; one that owns only an operation; and a root with no documents and no owned element whose `reviewer` is absent or is not `none`." This covers the object-type, (attached) constraint and operation boundaries plus reviewer, but no case owns a fact type, a top-level constraint, or an obligation — three of the five ownership boundaries §2's D4 rule ('it owns no object type, no fact type, no constraint wherever it is written ..., no operation and no obligation') and §6's own sentence name. §6's 'one case per boundary' claim is therefore inaccurate, and a U1-relaxation leak through an owned fact type, top-level constraint or obligation would exit 0 without any named focused gate catching it.

concerns.recommendation: Add keep-U1 cases to VG4-C3 for a root owning only a fact type, a top-level constraint, and an operation obligation (or narrow §6's parenthetical to the boundaries VG4-C3 actually tests); the D4 ownership rule in §2 is complete as written, so this is a criterion-completeness fix, not a rule change.
concerns.title: VG4-C3 does not test one case per U1 boundary that §6 claims

summary: r2's (p1) repairs were checked against the repository: H13's corrected citations, H30-H36, D13/D14 against _unattended.py, _includes.py and checking.py, the D2 (b) branches, VG1-C7/C8, VG3-C2/C3/C5/C8/C9/C10, project.md:129-131 and the growth-round-outcomes overlap all hold, and D4(a) leaves no path for a root with its own claim to validate without a source document. One inconsistency remains: section 6 claims VG4-C3 pins one keep-U1 case per ownership boundary, but VG4-C3 omits the owned fact type, top-level constraint and obligation boundaries that section 2's D4 rule and section 6's own enumeration name.
